description: Use when the user asks what data the platform holds on a subject, or where a dataset comes from and under which licence. Searches the platform's data catalogue (geo.nlp-tlp.org/data). Returns each dataset's title, summary, family, coverage, source, licence (and whether commercial use is allowed), row count, last update, its catalogue page, and the map layer ids it draws (make_map_link shows them). The ~600 DMIRS DASC packages of the WA data library are searched with search_wa_data_library.

family.description: A family key from an earlier answer (e.g. geophysics, tenure).

q.description: Words in a title or summary; empty lists everything.

name: search_data_catalogue
title: Search the data catalogue
